response.overview: The funeral of Luisa Amato takes places during a hot mid-july day in Sicily, in the little town of San Giovanni. In front of the great church, two men meet again after twenty years. Pietro was eighteen years old when he left with his father to have a summer holiday in Sicily. Soon, he noticed that his father’s presence in Sicily was only due to his business. Deeply disappointed, Pietro started to take long walk alone. While walking, he found on the street an old woman that welcomed him in her little house. Under a flowers-decorated pergola, Pietro found an old book marked with a withered poppy. The sudden arrival of Tommaso, a confident light-hearted boy, marked a silent encounter that will forever change the course of their lives.
response.title: L'estate dei papaveri rossi
